GREEN: Basic negotiation inside approved rate ranges
YELLOW: Added deliverables (e.g. extra Shorts, IG stories)
Request for revision beyond agreed limit
RED: Usage rights: paid ads, whitelisting, perpetual, repurposing
Any legal edits to contract — FLAG_LEGAL_CHANGE
Requests to change governing law or jurisdiction
Requests to remove broker from contract
Demands for influencer personal information beyond what is in contract

too_expensive.if_within_10_percent: Counter with same deliverables at slightly lower rate or propose removing one deliverable to hit their number
too_expensive.response_hint: Propose reducing one deliverable (e.g. drop IG stories) to meet their budget without dropping the video rate

exclusivity_requested.action: Hard stop. Escalate to owner immediately. Never auto-accept. If owner approves, exclusivity carries a mandatory premium of 25% on top of agreed rate.

audience_mismatch.response_hint: Send engagement data and niche overlap analysis. Reference past campaign performance in adjacent niches.

add_shorts_or_stories.response_hint: Draft counter with adjusted pricing. Shorts: +$200-500. IG stories (3x15sec): +$300-800. Flag for owner approval.

legal_edits.action: FLAG_LEGAL_CHANGE. Hard stop. Never respond or accept. Notify owner immediately with exact clause quoted.

usage_rights_ads.action: Hard stop. Escalate RED. Usage rights for paid media require a separate licensing fee negotiated by owner.

late_payment.response_hint: Confirm Stripe invoice was received. Resend link. If 7+ days late, escalate to owner.

wants_more_revisions.response_hint: Politely note the revision limit in contract. If they want to exceed, draft an addendum with a revision fee.

auto_accept_logic: IF counter_price >= walkaway_price: RED. IF counter_price between target and walkaway AND no RED flags: GREEN, can auto-accept. IF price_change > 10%: YELLOW.
